docs.title: 프로젝트 설명(Project description)
docs.text: 여러 언어가 섞인 채팅 기록을 불러와 정제하고 개인정보를 마스킹하는 전처리 기능을 개발합니다. (We build a preprocessing package that loads multilingual chat logs, cleans them, and masks personal information.)

docs.title: 주요 기능(Main features)
docs.text:
• UTF-8 인코딩으로 여러 언어가 섞인 채팅 기록 불러오기(Load multilingual chat logs encoded in UTF-8)
  • 메시지별로 시간, 발언자, 발언 내용을 파싱(Parse the time, speaker, and content of each message)
  • 시간 형식을 통일하고 발언 순서대로 정렬 (시간이 같으면 원본 순서 유지)(Normalize time formats and sort by time; equal times keep the original order)
  • 고정된 패턴의 시스템 메시지를 식별해 제거(Identify and remove system messages with fixed patterns)
  • 정규표현식으로 전화번호와 이메일을 찾아 대체 문자열로 마스킹(Find phone numbers and emails with regular expressions and mask them)

docs.title: 목표(Goals)
docs.text:
• 위의 주요 기능을 모두 구현합니다(Implement all of the main features above).
  • 테스트 샘플의 출력 결과가 기대 결과와 일치해야 합니다(The output for the test sample must match the expected result).
  • 발언 내용은 전화번호와 이메일이 마스킹된 부분 외에는 원문과 동일해야 합니다(Message content must stay identical to the original except for the masked phone numbers and emails).

docs.title: API
docs.text:
Core functions of chatlog_cleaner.

Input format

One message per line, written as [time] speaker: content, for example [2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕. This is the format of this project. The export formats of KakaoTalk are not supported yet: the PC version writes [민수] [오후 2:05] 안녕 and the mobile version writes 2026년 11월 9일 오후 2:05, 민수 : 안녕.

Processing order
  1. load_chat: read the file into lines.
  2. parse_messages: turn the lines into message dicts.
  3. normalize_time: rewrite the time of every message.
  4. sort_messages: sort by time. This step needs step 3 first, because times are compared as strings.
  5. remove_system_messages: drop join and leave notices.
  6. mask_pii: mask the text of every message.
Not provided yet

clean_chat(src, dst): runs steps 1 to 6 and writes the result to a new UTF-8 file in the input format, without changing the original file. normalize_time only raises ValueError and never skips anything itself. Skipping is the job of clean_chat: when normalize_time raises ValueError for one message, clean_chat skips only that message and shows a warning, so that one bad line does not stop the whole file.

Out of scope

Masking names, addresses, and other personal data besides phone numbers and emails; translation; images and file attachments.

docs.title: load_chat(path)
docs.text:
Read a chat log file and return its lines.

The file is read as UTF-8 first. A byte order mark (BOM) at the start is removed. If the file is not valid UTF-8, it is read again as CP949.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default path str

Path to the chat log file. Encoded in UTF-8 (with or without BOM) or CP949.

required

Returns:

Type Description list[str]

One string per line, without trailing newlines. Both \n and \r\n line endings are handled. An empty file gives an empty list. The original file is not modified.

Raises:

Type Description FileNotFoundError

If path does not exist.

UnicodeDecodeError

If the file is neither UTF-8 nor CP949.

Note

The example below reads examples/chat.txt. This file must be added to the repository together with the implementation, and its first line must be [2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕하세요.

Examples:

>>> load_chat("examples/chat.txt")[0]
'[2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕하세요'
Source code in src/chatlog_cleaner/core.py 
def load_chat(path):
    """Read a chat log file and return its lines.

    The file is read as UTF-8 first. A byte order mark (BOM) at the
    start is removed. If the file is not valid UTF-8, it is read again
    as CP949.

    Args:
        path (str): Path to the chat log file. Encoded in UTF-8
            (with or without BOM) or CP949.

    Returns:
        list[str]: One string per line, without trailing newlines.
        Both ``\\n`` and ``\\r\\n`` line endings are handled. An empty
        file gives an empty list. The original file is not modified.

    Raises:
        FileNotFoundError: If ``path`` does not exist.
        UnicodeDecodeError: If the file is neither UTF-8 nor CP949.

    Note:
        The example below reads ``examples/chat.txt``. This file must be
        added to the repository together with the implementation, and
        its first line must be ``[2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕하세요``.

    Examples:
        >>> load_chat("examples/chat.txt")[0]
        '[2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕하세요'
    """
    raise NotImplementedError

docs.title: mask_pii(text)
docs.text:
Mask phone numbers and email addresses in one message.

Masked:

  • Emails such as kim@example.com.
  • Korean mobile numbers (010, 011, 016 to 019), Seoul numbers (02), area numbers (031 to 035, 041 to 045, 051 to 055, 061 to 065), and internet phone numbers (070). The parts may be joined by -, ., a space, or nothing, as in 010-1234-5678 or 01012345678. A +82 prefix with or without the first 0 also works, as in +82 10-1234-5678.

Not masked:

  • Numbers such as 1588-1234, foreign numbers such as +1 212-555-1234, and resident registration numbers such as 901010-1234567.
  • Names, addresses, and any other personal data.

Emails are masked before phone numbers. If phone numbers were masked first, an email such as 01012345678@naver.com would become [PHONE]@naver.com. Digits that are part of a longer number, such as an order number, are not masked.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default text str

Message content. May mix Korean and English.

required

Returns:

Type Description str

The text with phone numbers replaced by [PHONE] and emails by [EMAIL]. Everything else is unchanged.

Examples:

>>> mask_pii("연락처 010-1234-5678, mail kim@example.com")
'연락처 [PHONE], mail [EMAIL]'
Source code in src/chatlog_cleaner/core.py 
def mask_pii(text):
    """Mask phone numbers and email addresses in one message.

    Masked:

    - Emails such as ``kim@example.com``.
    - Korean mobile numbers (010, 011, 016 to 019), Seoul numbers (02),
      area numbers (031 to 035, 041 to 045, 051 to 055, 061 to 065),
      and internet phone numbers (070).
      The parts may be joined by ``-``, ``.``, a space, or nothing,
      as in ``010-1234-5678`` or ``01012345678``. A ``+82`` prefix
      with or without the first ``0`` also works, as in
      ``+82 10-1234-5678``.

    Not masked:

    - Numbers such as ``1588-1234``, foreign numbers such as
      ``+1 212-555-1234``, and resident registration numbers such as
      ``901010-1234567``.
    - Names, addresses, and any other personal data.

    Emails are masked before phone numbers. If phone numbers were
    masked first, an email such as ``01012345678@naver.com`` would
    become ``[PHONE]@naver.com``. Digits that are part of a longer
    number, such as an order number, are not masked.

    Args:
        text (str): Message content. May mix Korean and English.

    Returns:
        str: The text with phone numbers replaced by ``[PHONE]`` and
        emails by ``[EMAIL]``. Everything else is unchanged.

    Examples:
        >>> mask_pii("연락처 010-1234-5678, mail kim@example.com")
        '연락처 [PHONE], mail [EMAIL]'
    """
    text = _EMAIL_RE.sub("[EMAIL]", text)
    text = _PHONE_RE.sub("[PHONE]", text)
    return text

docs.title: normalize_time(raw)
docs.text:
Convert a time string into the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

Supported formats:

  • 2026-11-09 14:05
  • 2026.11.9 14:05
  • 2026.11.9 오후 2:05 or 2026.11.9 PM 2:05
  • 2026년 11월 9일 오후 2:05 or 2026년 11월 9일 14:05
  • 11/09/2026 14:05 (month/day/year)

오전/오후 and AM/PM can be used in every format. 오전/오후 comes before the time. AM/PM may come before or after it, as in 11/09/2026 2:05 PM. With one of these, the hour must be 1 to 12, so 오후 14:05 is an error. 오전 12:30 is 00:30 and 오후 12:30 is 12:30. Month, day, and hour may have one or two digits. Minutes must have two digits, so 2:5 is an error. Spaces at the start and end are ignored. Seconds are not supported.

A time in no supported format is not guessed, because a wrong guess gives a wrong order without any warning. A date that does not exist, such as 2026.13.40, is also an error.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default raw str

A time in one of the supported formats.

required

Returns:

Type Description str

The same moment written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

Raises:

Type Description ValueError

If raw matches none of the supported formats, or the date or time does not exist.

Examples:

>>> normalize_time("2026.11.9 오후 2:05")
'2026-11-09 14:05'
>>> normalize_time("2026년 11월 9일 오전 9:30")
'2026-11-09 09:30'
Source code in src/chatlog_cleaner/core.py 
def normalize_time(raw):
    """Convert a time string into the format ``YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM``.

    Supported formats:

    - ``2026-11-09 14:05``
    - ``2026.11.9 14:05``
    - ``2026.11.9 오후 2:05`` or ``2026.11.9 PM 2:05``
    - ``2026년 11월 9일 오후 2:05`` or ``2026년 11월 9일 14:05``
    - ``11/09/2026 14:05`` (month/day/year)

    ``오전``/``오후`` and ``AM``/``PM`` can be used in every format.
    ``오전``/``오후`` comes before the time. ``AM``/``PM`` may come before
    or after it, as in ``11/09/2026 2:05 PM``. With one of these, the
    hour must be 1 to 12, so ``오후 14:05`` is an error.
    ``오전 12:30`` is ``00:30`` and ``오후 12:30`` is ``12:30``.
    Month, day, and hour may have one or two digits. Minutes must have
    two digits, so ``2:5`` is an error. Spaces at the
    start and end are ignored. Seconds are not supported.

    A time in no supported format is not guessed, because a wrong
    guess gives a wrong order without any warning. A date that does
    not exist, such as ``2026.13.40``, is also an error.

    Args:
        raw (str): A time in one of the supported formats.

    Returns:
        str: The same moment written as ``YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM``.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If ``raw`` matches none of the supported formats,
            or the date or time does not exist.

    Examples:
        >>> normalize_time("2026.11.9 오후 2:05")
        '2026-11-09 14:05'
        >>> normalize_time("2026년 11월 9일 오전 9:30")
        '2026-11-09 09:30'
    """
    raise NotImplementedError

docs.title: parse_messages(lines)
docs.text:
Split each line into time, speaker, and content.

Each line is handled by the first rule that matches:

  1. Empty lines and date lines such as 2026년 11월 9일 일요일 or --------------- 2026년 11월 9일 일요일 --------------- are skipped. The date in a date line is not used. An empty line inside a message with several lines is also skipped.
  2. [time] speaker: content starts a new message. The line is split at the first ": " after ], so the content may contain ": " but the speaker name may not.
  3. [time] content with no "speaker: " is a system message, such as [2026-11-09 14:06] 지은님이 들어왔습니다.. It starts a new message whose speaker is ''. It must not be joined to the previous message, or remove_system_messages cannot remove it.
  4. Any other line is the next line of a message with several lines. It is added to the text of the previous message. Such a line before the first message is skipped.

[time] means any text in square brackets at the start of the line. The text inside is not checked here. So a line of a message with several lines that starts with [, such as [참고] 내일, is read as a new message by rule 2 or 3.

The time is kept as written. normalize_time converts it. Spaces at the start and end of speaker and text are removed.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default lines list[str]

Lines from load_chat.

required

Returns:

Type Description list[dict]

One dict per message with keys time, speaker and text, in the order of the input. Lines of one message are joined with \n.

Examples:

>>> parse_messages(["[2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕"])
[{'time': '2026-11-09 14:05', 'speaker': '민수', 'text': '안녕'}]
>>> parse_messages(["[2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕", "반가워"])
[{'time': '2026-11-09 14:05', 'speaker': '민수', 'text': '안녕\n반가워'}]
>>> parse_messages(["[2026-11-09 14:06] 지은님이 들어왔습니다."])
[{'time': '2026-11-09 14:06', 'speaker': '', 'text': '지은님이 들어왔습니다.'}]
Source code in src/chatlog_cleaner/core.py 
def parse_messages(lines):
    """Split each line into time, speaker, and content.

    Each line is handled by the first rule that matches:

    1. Empty lines and date lines such as ``2026년 11월 9일 일요일`` or
       ``--------------- 2026년 11월 9일 일요일 ---------------`` are
       skipped. The date in a date line is not used. An empty line
       inside a message with several lines is also skipped.
    2. ``[time] speaker: content`` starts a new message. The line is
       split at the first ``": "`` after ``]``, so the content may
       contain ``": "`` but the speaker name may not.
    3. ``[time] content`` with no ``"speaker: "`` is a system message,
       such as ``[2026-11-09 14:06] 지은님이 들어왔습니다.``. It starts a
       new message whose ``speaker`` is ``''``. It must not be joined
       to the previous message, or ``remove_system_messages`` cannot
       remove it.
    4. Any other line is the next line of a message with several
       lines. It is added to the ``text`` of the previous message.
       Such a line before the first message is skipped.

    ``[time]`` means any text in square brackets at the start of the
    line. The text inside is not checked here. So a line of a message
    with several lines that starts with ``[``, such as ``[참고] 내일``,
    is read as a new message by rule 2 or 3.

    The ``time`` is kept as written. ``normalize_time`` converts it.
    Spaces at the start and end of ``speaker`` and ``text`` are removed.

    Args:
        lines (list[str]): Lines from ``load_chat``.

    Returns:
        list[dict]: One dict per message with keys ``time``,
        ``speaker`` and ``text``, in the order of the input. Lines of
        one message are joined with ``\\n``.

    Examples:
        >>> parse_messages(["[2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕"])
        [{'time': '2026-11-09 14:05', 'speaker': '민수', 'text': '안녕'}]
        >>> parse_messages(["[2026-11-09 14:05] 민수: 안녕", "반가워"])
        [{'time': '2026-11-09 14:05', 'speaker': '민수', 'text': '안녕\\n반가워'}]
        >>> parse_messages(["[2026-11-09 14:06] 지은님이 들어왔습니다."])
        [{'time': '2026-11-09 14:06', 'speaker': '', 'text': '지은님이 들어왔습니다.'}]
    """
    raise NotImplementedError

docs.title: remove_system_messages(messages)
docs.text:
Remove system messages such as join and leave notices.

A message is removed only when both are true:

  • Its speaker is '' or it has no speaker key. parse_messages gives '' to lines with no speaker.
  • Its text contains one of the known system patterns: 님이 들어왔습니다, 님이 나갔습니다, 님을 초대했습니다, 님을 내보냈습니다.

Because of the first rule, a person who writes one of these patterns in a normal message is not removed. A system message with a pattern that is not in the list is kept, so users must check the result.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default messages list[dict]

Parsed messages with a text key.

required

Returns:

Type Description list[dict]

A new list without the system messages, in the same order. The input list is not changed.

Examples:

>>> msgs = [{'text': '민수님이 들어왔습니다.'}, {'text': 'hi'}]
>>> remove_system_messages(msgs)
[{'text': 'hi'}]
Source code in src/chatlog_cleaner/core.py 
def remove_system_messages(messages):
    """Remove system messages such as join and leave notices.

    A message is removed only when both are true:

    - Its ``speaker`` is ``''`` or it has no ``speaker`` key.
      ``parse_messages`` gives ``''`` to lines with no speaker.
    - Its ``text`` contains one of the known system patterns:
      ``님이 들어왔습니다``, ``님이 나갔습니다``, ``님을 초대했습니다``,
      ``님을 내보냈습니다``.

    Because of the first rule, a person who writes one of these
    patterns in a normal message is not removed. A system message with
    a pattern that is not in the list is kept, so users must check the
    result.

    Args:
        messages (list[dict]): Parsed messages with a ``text`` key.

    Returns:
        list[dict]: A new list without the system messages, in the same
        order. The input list is not changed.

    Examples:
        >>> msgs = [{'text': '민수님이 들어왔습니다.'}, {'text': 'hi'}]
        >>> remove_system_messages(msgs)
        [{'text': 'hi'}]
    """
    raise NotImplementedError

docs.title: sort_messages(messages)
docs.text:
Sort messages by time, keeping the original order for equal times.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default messages list[dict]

Messages with a time key. Every time must already be converted by normalize_time. Times are compared as strings, so a time in another format is put in a wrong place without any error.

required

Returns:

Type Description list[dict]

A new sorted list. The input list is not changed. The dicts are not copied: the new list holds the same dicts.

Examples:

>>> msgs = [{'time': '2026-11-09 14:06', 'text': 'b'},
...         {'time': '2026-11-09 14:05', 'text': 'a'}]
>>> [m['text'] for m in sort_messages(msgs)]
['a', 'b']
Source code in src/chatlog_cleaner/core.py 
def sort_messages(messages):
    """Sort messages by time, keeping the original order for equal times.

    Args:
        messages (list[dict]): Messages with a ``time`` key. Every
            ``time`` must already be converted by ``normalize_time``.
            Times are compared as strings, so a time in another format
            is put in a wrong place without any error.

    Returns:
        list[dict]: A new sorted list. The input list is not changed.
        The dicts are not copied: the new list holds the same dicts.

    Examples:
        >>> msgs = [{'time': '2026-11-09 14:06', 'text': 'b'},
        ...         {'time': '2026-11-09 14:05', 'text': 'a'}]
        >>> [m['text'] for m in sort_messages(msgs)]
        ['a', 'b']
    """
    return sorted(messages, key=lambda message: message["time"])

만들고 싶은 프로그램(What we want to build)
docs.text: 여러 언어가 섞인 채팅 기록을 불러와 정제하고, 전화번호와 이메일 같은 개인정보를 마스킹하는 전처리 Python 패키지를 개발한다. (We will build a Python package that loads multilingual chat logs, cleans them, and masks personal information such as phone numbers and email addresses.)

docs.title: 사용자 정의 및 해결할 문제(Users and problem)
docs.text: 채팅 기록을 분석하거나 데이터셋으로 공유하려는 사용자는 시간 형식이 제각각이고, 시스템 메시지가 섞여 있으며, 전화번호와 이메일이 그대로 노출된 기록을 직접 하나씩 정리하고 가려야 한다. 이 프로그램은 파싱, 시간 형식 통일, 정렬, 시스템 메시지 제거, 개인정보 마스킹을 한 번에 처리해 이 반복 작업을 줄여 준다. (Users who want to analyze chat logs or share them as a dataset must manually clean logs with inconsistent time formats and mixed-in system messages, and hide exposed phone numbers and emails one by one. This program parses, normalizes time formats, sorts, removes system messages, and masks personal information in one pass, reducing this repetitive work.)

docs.title: 입력(Input)
docs.text: 사용자가 컴퓨터에 저장한 UTF-8 인코딩의 채팅 기록 파일. 한국어, 영어 등 여러 언어가 섞여 있으며, 각 메시지에는 시간, 발언자, 발언 내용이 포함된다. (A UTF-8 encoded chat log file stored on the user's computer. It mixes multiple languages such as Korean and English, and each message contains a time, a speaker, and the message content.)

docs.title: 처리(Processing)
docs.text:
1. UTF-8 인코딩으로 여러 언어가 섞인 채팅 기록 파일을 불러온다(Load the multilingual chat log file with UTF-8 encoding).
  2. 메시지별로 시간, 발언자, 발언 내용을 파싱한다(Parse the time, speaker, and content of each message).
  3. 시간 형식을 하나로 통일한다(Normalize all times into a single format).
  4. 발언 시간 순서대로 정렬하고, 시간이 같으면 원본 순서를 유지한다(Sort messages by time; messages with the same time keep their original order).
  5. 고정된 패턴의 시스템 메시지를 식별해 제거한다(Identify and remove system messages that follow fixed patterns).
  6. 정규표현식으로 전화번호와 이메일을 찾아 대체 문자열로 마스킹한다(Find phone numbers and email addresses with regular expressions and replace them with mask strings).

docs.title: 결과(Output)
docs.text: 정제된 채팅 기록을 입력 파일과 같은 형식의 UTF-8 파일로 새로 저장한다. 각 메시지는 통일된 시간 형식, 발언자, 발언 내용으로 구성되고 시간 순서대로 정렬된다. 시스템 메시지는 제거되며, 발언 내용은 전화번호와 이메일이 마스킹된 부분 외에는 원문과 동일하게 보존한다. 원본 파일은 수정하지 않는다. (The program saves the cleaned chat log as a new UTF-8 file in the same format as the input file. Each message consists of a normalized time, the speaker, and the content, sorted by time. System messages are removed, and message content stays identical to the original except for the masked phone numbers and emails. The original file is not modified.)

docs.title: 개발 범위(Scope)
docs.text:
• 포함할 기능(In scope): UTF-8 다국어 채팅 기록 불러오기, 메시지 파싱, 시간 형식 통일 및 정렬, 고정 패턴 시스템 메시지 제거, 전화번호·이메일 마스킹(Loading UTF-8 multilingual chat logs, parsing messages, normalizing and sorting times, removing fixed-pattern system messages, and masking phone numbers and emails).
  • 제외할 기능(Out of scope): 이름·주소 등 전화번호와 이메일 외 개인정보 마스킹, 번역, 이미지·파일 첨부 처리(Masking personal information other than phone numbers and emails such as names or addresses, translation, and handling attached images or files).
  • 한계(Limitation): 정규표현식에 맞지 않는 비표준 형식의 전화번호나 이메일, 정의되지 않은 패턴의 시스템 메시지는 처리되지 않을 수 있으므로 결과를 직접 확인해야 한다(Phone numbers or emails in non-standard formats and system messages with undefined patterns may not be handled, so the output must be checked manually).

docs.title: 사용 예시(Usage example)
docs.text: 사용자가 한국어와 영어가 섞인 채팅 기록 chat.txt를 입력한다. 프로그램은 메시지를 파싱해 시간 형식을 통일하고 시간 순서대로 정렬한 뒤, 입장·퇴장 같은 시스템 메시지를 제거하고 전화번호와 이메일을 마스킹해 chat_clean.txt를 새로 저장한다. 사용자는 테스트 샘플의 출력 결과가 기대 결과와 일치하는지, 마스킹된 부분 외의 발언 내용이 원문과 같은지 확인한다. (The user provides chat.txt, a chat log mixing Korean and English. The program parses the messages, normalizes time formats, sorts them by time, removes system messages such as join and leave notices, masks phone numbers and emails, and saves a new file, chat_clean.txt. The user checks that the output for the test sample matches the expected result and that message content is identical to the original except for the masked parts.)

docs.title: 팀 규칙(Team rules): "다국어 채팅 기록 전처리기(Multilingual Chat Log Preprocessor)"
PR 크기(Pull request size)
docs.text:
• PR 하나에는 기능 하나 또는 수정 하나만 포함하며, 변경 줄 수는 약 100줄 이내로 한다(One pull request contains one function or one fix, about 100 changed lines).
  • 파싱, 시간 정렬, 시스템 메시지 제거, 마스킹은 각각 별도의 PR로 올린다(Parsing, time sorting, system message removal, and masking are submitted as separate pull requests).

docs.title: 리뷰 규칙(Review)
docs.text:
• 모든 PR은 작성자를 제외한 팀원 2명 이상이 리뷰한다(Every pull request is reviewed by at least two members other than the author).
  • 리뷰는 PR이 올라온 뒤 48시간 이내에 완료한다(Reviews are completed within 48 hours of the pull request being opened).
  • blocking: 코멘트가 하나라도 해결되지 않았으면 머지하지 않는다(A pull request is not merged while any blocking: comment is unresolved).
  • 리뷰어는 연결된 이슈와 일치하는지, 테스트 샘플의 출력이 기대 결과와 같은지, 마스킹된 부분 외의 발언 내용이 원문과 같은지 확인한다(Reviewers check that the change matches the linked issue, that the test sample output matches the expected result, and that message content is identical to the original except for the masked parts).

docs.title: 머지 규칙(Merge)
docs.text:
• 마지막으로 승인한 리뷰어가 머지 버튼을 누른다(The last approving reviewer presses the merge button).
  • 머지 옵션은 "Create a merge commit"을 사용한다(Use "Create a merge commit").
  • 머지 후 브랜치를 삭제한다(Delete the branch after merging).
  • main 브랜치에 직접 push하지 않는다(No one pushes directly to main).

docs.title: 브랜치 이름(Branch names)
docs.text:
• 새 기능(New feature): feat/<name>
  • 버그 수정(Bug fix): fix/<name>
  • 문서(Documentation): docs/<name>
  • 설정 및 기타(Configuration and others): chore/<name>

docs.title: 커밋 메시지(Commit messages)
docs.text: • 영역: 한 문장 설명 형식으로 쓴다(Use the format area: one-sentence description).

docs.title: 소통 채널(Communication)
docs.text: • 팀 논의는 카카오톡 단톡방에서 하고, 결정 사항은 GitHub 이슈에 기록한다(Team discussion happens in the KakaoTalk group chat, and decisions are recorded in GitHub issues).

docs.title: AI 사용 공개(AI use)
docs.text:
• 모든 PR의 ## AI use 섹션에 사용한 도구, 적용한 파일·함수, 사용 방식(생성, 완성, 리팩터링, 설명, 리뷰), 직접 수정하거나 확인한 내용을 적는다(Every pull request states in its ## AI use section the tool, the files or functions, how it was used (generated, completed, refactored, explained, or reviewed), and what the author changed or verified by hand).
  • AI를 사용하지 않았으면 none이라고 적는다. 비워 두거나 "used ChatGPT"처럼만 쓰면 인정되지 않는다(If no AI was used, write none. Leaving it blank or writing only "used ChatGPT" is not accepted).
  • 작성자는 AI가 생성한 코드를 포함해 PR의 모든 줄을 설명할 수 있어야 한다(The author must be able to explain every line of the pull request, including AI-generated code).
